blocks.text: RESOLUTION NO. 9821
CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT

RESOLUTION introduced by City Manager Dr. Robert M. Perez, in accordance with Section 18.60.010 of the Topeka Municipal Code, approving a Conditional Use Permit to allow for a Short-Term Rental, Type II (non-owner occupied) that is within 500 ft of another Short Term Rental on property located at 1171 SW Medford Avenue and zoned "R-2" Single-Family Dwelling District, all being within the City of Topeka, Shawnee County, Kansas. (CU26/02) (Council District No. 6)

BE IT RESOLVED by the Governing Body of the City of Topeka, Kansas, that the application under the provisions of TMC 18.60.010, approving a Conditional Use Permit to allow for a Short Term Rental Type II that is within 500 ft of another Short Term Rental on property zoned “R-2” Single Family Dwelling District, located at 1171 SW Medford Avenue and more specifically legally described as follows:
WASHBURN PLACE (AMENDED) , Lot 397 AND 399, AND ADJACENT 1/2 VAC ALLEY, MEDFORD AVENUE
be, and the same is hereby approved, subject to:
Use and development of the site in accordance with the approved Conditional Use Permit (CU26/02) and Statement of Operations from applicant.

In the event of substantial changes in operations, the applicant shall submit a revised Statement of Operations to the Planning Department to allow staff to ascertain compliance with the Conditional Use Permit.

The Conditional Use Permit for the Short Term Rental, Type II shall expire after a period of 24 months from the date of its approval by the Topeka Governing Body or no sooner than July 26, 2026, whichever of these dates occurs last. Kansas House Bill 2481 allows unrestricted operation of a short term rental at the subject address during the period of May 15, 2026 through July 25, 2026. If, upon a written request made by the owner within six months from date of the expiration of the conditional use permit, and after finding that the short term rental has and will continue to comply with all special use requirements for a short term residential rental type II with exception of standard (aa)(1)(ix) regarding its distance from any other short term rental type II, the Planning Director may approve one extension of the conditional use permit not to exceed an additional 24 months.
ADOPTED AND APPROVED by the Governing Body of the City of Topeka on June 16, 2026.
CITY OF TOPEKA, KANSAS
Spencer L. Duncan, Mayor
ATTEST:
Brenda Younger, City Clerk
EXHIBIT A
Statement of Operations
Conditional Use Permit for Short Term Rental Type II at 1171 SW Medford Avenue

The "Medford House," as my family and I call it, has been in our family for roughly 28 years. It has served as my childhood home and a long-term rental property; soon, I hope it will become a short-term rental (STR).

The Medford House offers two bedrooms and one bath for guests to enjoy. While I am new to the STR space and expect a learning experience, I will implement a two-night minimum stay. Trash services will continue to be provided by the City of Topeka. I will also enforce a "quiet time" from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., and no parties will be allowed.

The property will host transient guests with no representative living on-site. However, my goal is not a fully booked schedule every month; I simply want the property to pay for itself while remaining a place I can stay when I return home to visit family.

Once I move out, the property will be managed by myself and my family. The 2 main points of contact for managing will be my Aunt Pam Metzger (785) 286-2198 and Uncle Ken Metzger (785) 220-4825. The yard and flowers will be on a regular schedule for mowing and watering to ensure the home remains visually appealing. This project is ongoing, and I will continue to improve the property throughout the permitting process and beyond. Over the past 18 months, I have already made significant improvements, including adding new rock to the driveway, remodeling the front and back porches, replacing gutters on the house and garage, and painting the exterior. My goal is for this property to be one of the nicest homes on the street while maintaining the historic feel of the neighborhood.
